clippings.speaker: Sophia Loren
clippings.quote: And it was really fun to give Marcello Mastroianni a chance to be terribly funny, as he was, actually. And that was, I think, really the brilliancy of the film.
clippings.title: Sophia Loren recalls striptease scene from 'Yesterday, Today and Tomorrow'
clippings.context: Asked by Fox News' Stephanie Nolasco about the striptease scene in the 1963 film.

clippings.speaker: Sophia Loren
clippings.quote: The two of us, we’re so good together we can do anything. Ours is always a magical encounter.
clippings.title: Sophia Loren
clippings.context: Answering Alain Elkann on the actors she most enjoyed working with, after their reunion on Robert Altman's Prêt-à-Porter; interview held in Geneva on 3 Sept 1994 and republished by the site on 14 Feb 2014.

clippings.speaker: Sophia Loren
clippings.quote: Every time I was asked to do a film with Marcello, I said, ‘Yes, yes, yes,’ without reading a script. Because I knew that with him everything was going to be alright.
clippings.title: Sophia Loren on Working with Marcello Mastroianni
clippings.context: Criterion's excerpt from its interview for the Ettore Scola film A Special Day; I read it only as quoted in Paste's 2024 Film School column, and the date is the Criterion YouTube upload date.

clippings.speaker: Marcello Mastroianni
clippings.quote: In this film she eats all of the other actresses; she plays a very powerful character.
clippings.title: Marcello Mastroianni
clippings.context: Asked in a Paris cafe interview with Alain Elkann (meeting dated 15 June 1994; page posted 2016) whether he had acted with Loren in Altman's film.

notes: Mastroianni-side is thin: his quotes about Loren I could only verify from the 1994 Elkann interview, and a Paste-quoted 1987 remark had no traceable original, so I skipped it.
